name: INSPIRE-HEP
description: Literature database for high-energy physics covering preprints, journal articles, conference proceedings, authors, and institutions, operated by CERN and partner institutions.

name: SAO/NASA Astrophysics Data System
description: Digital library for astronomy, astrophysics, and physics literature, indexing abstracts and full texts from journals, preprints, and conference proceedings.
access_requirements: Free account required for API access and saved libraries.

name: PubChem
description: Database of chemical substances and their biological activities, providing structures, identifiers, properties, and links to patents and biomedical literature.

name: ChemRxiv
description: Open preprint server for chemistry where researchers share unpublished results before or during peer review, operated on the Cambridge Open Engage platform.

name: IUCr Journals
description: Crystallography journals published by the International Union of Crystallography, including the Acta Crystallographica sections and the Journal of Applied Crystallography.

name: MathSciNet
description: Searchable database of reviews, abstracts, and bibliographic information for mathematics research, produced by the American Mathematical Society.
access_requirements: Subscription required, usually through an institutional license.

name: zbMATH Open
description: Open-access database of reviews and abstracts for mathematics and its applications, provided by FIZ Karlsruhe as the successor to the subscription zbMATH service.

name: Materials Project
description: Database of computed properties for inorganic materials, including crystal structures, formation energies, and elastic and electronic data from high-throughput simulations.
access_requirements: Free account and API key required for programmatic access.

name: NIST Chemistry WebBook
description: Reference database of thermochemical, thermophysical, and ion energetics data for chemical species, including infrared, ultraviolet, and mass spectra.
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

name: Particle Data Group
description: Authoritative compilation of particle physics data, including the Review of Particle Physics with measured particle properties, constants, and interactive tools.

name: CERN Document Server
description: Institutional repository of CERN publications, preprints, reports, theses, photographs, and videos related to high-energy physics research.

name: HEPData
description: Repository of data tables from high-energy physics papers, preserving the numerical results behind published plots so they can be searched, visualized, and reused.

name: On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences
description: Searchable database of integer sequences with terms, formulas, references, and cross links, founded by Neil Sloane and maintained by the OEIS Foundation.

name: Wolfram MathWorld
description: Online encyclopedia of mathematics with entries on algebra, geometry, calculus, number theory, and related topics, maintained by Wolfram Research.

name: Mindat
description: Database of minerals, rocks, and meteorites with locality information, photographs, and property data, run by the Hudson Institute of Mineralogy and volunteers.

name: CERN Open Data portal
description: Portal giving access to research datasets from LHC experiments, together with software, documentation, and virtual machine environments for analysis.

name: IUPAC Gold Book
description: Online compendium of definitions for chemical terminology maintained by the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry, with searchable terms and citations.
publisher: International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry

name: Physical Review journals
description: Site of the Physical Review family of physics journals published by the American Physical Society, including Physical Review Letters and the Physical Review series.

name: IOPscience
description: Online platform for journals published by IOP Publishing, covering physics, materials science, biosciences, and related engineering disciplines.

name: CAS Common Chemistry
description: Open database of common chemical substances from the Chemical Abstracts Service, providing CAS Registry Numbers, structures, and names for widely used chemicals.

name: ACM Digital Library
description: Full-text library of journals, conference proceedings, magazines, and books published by the Association for Computing Machinery, covering all areas of computing.

name: IEEE Xplore
description: Digital library of IEEE and IET publications, including journals, conference proceedings, and standards across electrical engineering, electronics, and computing.

name: dblp
description: Bibliographic index of computer science publications, cataloguing journal articles, conference papers, and author profiles, operated by Schloss Dagstuhl and the University of Trier.
publisher: Schloss Dagstuhl, Leibniz Center for Informatics

name: OpenReview
description: Platform for open peer review of machine learning and computer science submissions, hosting papers, reviews, and public discussions for conferences and journals.
publisher: Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence and University of Massachusetts Amherst

name: IACR Cryptology ePrint Archive
description: Archive of preprints in cryptology and cryptography, providing rapid open access to research reports before or alongside their formal publication.

name: CiteSeerX
description: Public search engine and digital library for scientific papers with a focus on computer and information science, developed at Pennsylvania State University.

name: USENIX
description: Advanced computing systems association whose site hosts conference proceedings with freely available papers from venues such as OSDI, NSDI, USENIX Security, and FAST.

name: ACL Anthology
description: Digital archive of papers on computational linguistics and natural language processing, hosting proceedings of the ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, and related venues.

name: Proceedings of Machine Learning Research
description: Open-access series of machine learning conference proceedings, including ICML, AISTATS, and COLT, published by Machine Learning Research Press.

name: Journal of Machine Learning Research
description: Open-access journal publishing peer-reviewed research papers in machine learning, with free electronic access and an open review policy.

name: Transactions on Machine Learning Research
description: Open-access machine learning journal affiliated with the JMLR family, with a review model that judges scientific correctness and quality rather than novelty or significance.

name: Electronic Colloquium on Computational Complexity
description: Open archive of research reports in computational complexity theory, maintained at the Weizmann Institute of Science since 1994.

name: AAAI Conference Proceedings
description: Open-access proceedings of AAAI publications, including the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence, hosted on the AAAI Open Journal Systems platform.
publisher: Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence

name: NeurIPS Proceedings
description: Official proceedings of the Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems, providing free access to accepted papers, supplements, and reviews for recent years.

name: CVF Open Access
description: Open repository of papers and supplements from computer vision conferences sponsored by the Computer Vision Foundation, including CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV.

name: Dagstuhl DROPS
description: Publication platform of Schloss Dagstuhl hosting open-access computer science proceedings and journals, including the LIPIcs and OASIcs series.
publisher: Schloss Dagstuhl, Leibniz Center for Informatics

name: ACM Queue
description: Practitioner magazine published by the Association for Computing Machinery with in-depth articles on computing systems, software engineering, and emerging technology.

name: Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research
description: Open-access journal publishing peer-reviewed articles across all areas of artificial intelligence, including reasoning, machine learning, and natural language processing.

name: Hugging Face Hub
description: Collaboration platform hosting machine learning models, datasets, and applications, with versioning, model cards, usage licenses, and an API for programmatic access.
access_requirements: Account needed to upload, comment, or use gated models.

name: Kaggle Datasets
description: Collection of community-published datasets with documentation, notebooks, and discussion, integrated with Kaggle competitions and code environments.
access_requirements: Kaggle account required to download datasets.

name: OpenML
description: Open platform for sharing datasets, machine learning tasks, runs, and results, with APIs and integrations that support reproducible experiments and benchmarking.

name: UCI Machine Learning Repository
description: Long-running repository of datasets for machine learning and the empirical study of algorithms, maintained by the University of California, Irvine.

name: ImageNet
description: Image database organized by the WordNet hierarchy, providing millions of labeled images and the ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge benchmarks.
access_requirements: Registration and acceptance of terms required to download datasets.

name: Common Objects in Context (COCO)
description: Large-scale dataset for object detection, segmentation, and captioning, with images of everyday scenes containing common objects in their natural context.

name: GLUE benchmark
description: Collection of natural language understanding tasks with an evaluation server and leaderboard, introduced by researchers at NYU, the University of Washington, and DeepMind.

name: Mozilla Common Voice
description: Crowdsourced speech dataset project that collects validated voice recordings in many languages and releases public datasets for speech technology research.

name: Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD)
description: Reading comprehension dataset of questions posed on Wikipedia articles, with answers and an evaluation leaderboard for extractive question answering models.

name: OpenSLR
description: Site hosting speech and language resources, including the LibriSpeech corpus, TTS datasets, and pretrained models, for research on speech technology.

name: Google Dataset Search
description: Search engine that indexes datasets from thousands of repositories across the web using schema.org metadata provided by publishers.

name: Dynabench
description: Platform for creating and benchmarking NLP datasets through dynamic adversarial data collection, hosting tasks, leaderboards, and model evaluations.

name: CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100
description: Classic labeled image datasets of small color photographs in 10 and 100 classes, widely used as benchmarks for computer vision and machine learning research.

name: HELM (Holistic Evaluation of Language Models)
description: Framework and leaderboard for evaluating language models across scenarios and metrics such as accuracy, calibration, robustness, and fairness, from Stanford CRFM.

name: MLCommons
description: Industry consortium that develops and runs the MLPerf benchmark suites for training and inference performance, along with datasets and safety evaluation programs.

name: GitHub
description: Hosting service for git repositories that also provides issues, pull requests, actions, and package publishing, widely used for open-source and commercial software.

name: GitLab.com
description: Hosted instance of the GitLab DevOps platform providing git repositories, CI/CD pipelines, issue tracking, and container and package registries.

name: Python Package Index (PyPI)
description: Official package repository for Python, hosting distributions uploaded by the community and searchable through its website and JSON API.

name: npm Registry
description: Default package registry for the Node.js and JavaScript ecosystems, hosting packages with versioning, dependency metadata, and a public API.

name: crates.io
description: Package registry for the Rust ecosystem, hosting crates with versioned releases, documentation links, and download statistics.

name: Maven Central Repository
description: Primary registry for Java and JVM libraries, hosting Maven artifacts with searchable metadata, dependency information, and version histories.

name: RubyGems
description: Package registry for the Ruby community, hosting gems with dependency resolution, signed versions, and integration with the Bundler tool.

name: Packagist
description: Main package repository for PHP and Composer, aggregating package metadata, versions, and download statistics for PHP libraries and applications.

name: CPAN
description: Comprehensive Perl Archive Network, the worldwide archive of Perl modules, scripts, and documentation contributed and indexed by the Perl community.

name: CRAN
description: Comprehensive R Archive Network, the official repository of R packages with versioned releases, manuals, and mirror sites worldwide.

name: Bioconductor
description: Repository of R packages for the analysis and comprehension of high-throughput genomic data, with biannual releases and extensive documentation.

name: Docker Hub
description: Container image registry for discovering, distributing, and managing Docker images, including official images and community repositories.

name: Anaconda.org
description: Package hosting service for conda channels and other artifacts, supporting public and private distribution of environments and packages.

name: Hackage
description: Package database for the Haskell community, hosting libraries and programs with versioned uploads, build results, and documentation links.

name: CTAN
description: Comprehensive TeX Archive Network, the central archive of TeX and LaTeX packages, macros, fonts, and documentation with mirror sites worldwide.

name: Debian Packages
description: Official index of packages in the Debian archive, searchable by suite, section, architecture, and keywords, with dependency and download information.

name: Software Heritage
description: Archive that collects, preserves, and makes browsable the source code history of public software from GitHub, GitLab, PyPI, Debian, and other forges.

name: NuGet Gallery
description: Package registry for the .NET platform, hosting NuGet packages with versioning, dependency graphs, and download statistics.

name: MDN Web Docs
description: Reference and learning resource for web technologies, documenting HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Web APIs with guides, compatibility tables, and examples.

name: Python documentation
description: Official documentation for the Python language, including the language reference, standard library reference, tutorials, and version-specific guides.

name: The Rust Programming Language (the Book)
description: Official introductory book for the Rust programming language, covering installation, ownership, borrowing, modules, testing, and project structure.

name: Go documentation
description: Official documentation for the Go programming language, with tutorials, the language specification, the Effective Go guide, module reference, and release notes.

name: Kubernetes documentation
description: Official documentation for Kubernetes covering concepts, tasks, tutorials, setup guides, and the API reference for container orchestration.

name: PostgreSQL documentation
description: Official manual for the PostgreSQL database system, covering SQL reference, administration, replication, security, and client interfaces for each release.

name: Docker documentation
description: Official documentation for Docker products, covering container basics, the Docker Engine, Compose, build tooling, and security guidance.

name: AWS documentation
description: Official documentation for Amazon Web Services, with service guides, API references, tutorials, and best practices for cloud infrastructure.

name: Google Cloud documentation
description: Official documentation for Google Cloud products, providing quickstarts, how-to guides, API references, and architecture guidance.

name: Microsoft Learn
description: Documentation and training platform for Microsoft products, including Azure, .NET, Windows, SQL Server, and developer tooling, with modules and API references.

name: Linux man pages
description: Manual pages for Linux system calls, library functions, devices, file formats, and commands, maintained as the Linux man-pages project.

name: GNU manuals
description: Online manuals for GNU software such as Bash, Coreutils, Emacs, GCC, and Make, published by the Free Software Foundation.

name: Node.js documentation
description: Official documentation for Node.js, including the JavaScript runtime API reference, guides, and module support details for each release line.

name: Apache HTTP Server documentation
description: Official documentation for the Apache HTTP Server, with reference pages for directives, modules, virtual hosting, and security configuration.

name: SQLite documentation
description: Official documentation for the SQLite database engine, covering the SQL dialect, C API, file format, command-line shell, and performance considerations.

name: International Organization for Standardization
description: International standards body whose catalog covers ISO standards for industry, quality management, information security, and other fields, with previews and purchase options.
access_requirements: Standards must be purchased; catalog browsing and previews are free.

name: International Electrotechnical Commission
description: Standards body for electrical, electronic, and related technologies, publishing international standards and running conformity assessment schemes for electrotechnical fields.

name: International Telecommunication Union
description: United Nations agency for information and communication technologies, publishing ITU-T, ITU-R, and ITU-D recommendations that are freely available online.

name: World Wide Web Consortium (W3C)
description: International community that develops open web standards such as HTML, CSS, WCAG, and XML, with specifications, drafts, and group documents publicly available.

name: RFC Editor
description: Publisher of the RFC series of technical and organizational documents about the Internet, including IETF standards-track specifications, searchable and freely downloadable.

name: NIST
description: United States agency for measurement science that publishes standards guidance, FIPS publications, handbooks, and laboratory research data across science and engineering.
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

name: OASIS
description: Standards consortium developing open specifications for security, cloud, IoT, and document formats, with approved standards free to download.

name: ECMA International
description: Standards organization that publishes the ECMAScript language specification and standards for information and communication systems, free of charge.

name: American National Standards Institute
description: Coordinator of the United States voluntary standards system, overseeing American National Standards and representing the United States in ISO and IEC.

name: BSI Group
description: British standards body that publishes British Standards, certifies management systems, and provides standards training and software tools.

name: European Committee for Standardization (CEN)
description: European standards body that prepares voluntary European Standards (EN) for products, services, and systems across the European single market, together with CENELEC for electrotechnical fields.

name: IEEE Standards Association
description: Standards arm of IEEE that develops and publishes standards for networking, power and energy, safety, and software, including the IEEE 802 series, with some free access programs.
